name: Data set bar
author: Brett
description: Attaches a search / filter / sort bar to ANY data set (grid, list, tree, table), hidden until attached. Search, Filter and Sort are each their own registry asset (search-bar with scope dataset, filter-button, sort-control), reusable on their own, plus the combined data-set-bar asset. Attach by right-clicking a data set (Attach data set bar ▸ Top / Bottom / Inline / Floating, or one piece at a time), from the Registry Browser's asset cards (Attach to data set), by voice (console actions) or through the API / MCP / CLI (plugin-commands); detach the same way. Filter: rules per field with saved filters. Sort: multi-key with saved sorts. Search: field-scoped and fuzzy. Per-attachment config lives in this device's settings (local-first) with Reset to default. The top-bar search is an instance of the same search-bar asset.

items.title: List attached data sets
items.description: Lists every data set the bar or a piece is attached to on this device, with placement and what is applied.

items.title: Attach the data set bar
items.description: Attach the data set bar to a data set: args dataset, placement (top | bottom | inline | floating, optional), bar asset id (optional).

items.title: Detach the data set bar
items.description: Take the bar and every piece off a data set (its saved filters and sorts go too).

items.title: Attach one piece
items.description: Attach a search bar, filter button or sort control alone: args dataset, piece (search | filter | sort), asset id (optional).

items.title: Detach one piece
items.description: Take one piece off a data set: args dataset, piece.

items.title: Move the bar
items.description: Change where the bar sits on a data set: args dataset, placement.

items.title: Change the bar asset
items.description: Use another data-set-bar asset for a data set: args dataset, asset id.

items.title: Reset an attachment to default
items.description: Drop the attachment's overrides, applied search / rules / sort and the pill's spot; saved filters and sorts stay.

items.title: Search a data set
items.description: Set the bar's search text on a data set: args dataset, text (empty clears).

items.title: Clear a data set's search, rules and sort
